title: Camera follow — adaptive follow factor per axis (scale follow by 'how much arena overflows view'); tiny parallax minimum
intent: User feedback 2026-05-29: 'если сцена влазит в экран то не должно так сильно за ним следовать, небольшое движение должно быть, иначе сцена смещается от центра экрана непонятно зачем'. S163 camera-follow + edge-clamp keep the camera from sliding OFF-arena, but BETWEEN edge bounds the camera still follows the bomber at full rate. On arenas where the WHOLE arena fits in view (pit 11×11, corridor's Z axis 7 < 11), the camera shouldn't move at all — it should stay arena-centred. On arenas that mostly fit (plaza 13×11 X, default 15×11 X), the camera should follow only a TINY amount. This story adds an ADAPTIVE FOLLOW FACTOR per axis — when arena fits the view, follow_factor → 0; when arena is much bigger than view, follow_factor → 1.
rationale: Source: user feedback 2026-05-29. The current camera-follow from S163 + sudden-death + spawn-flicker from GDP-2026-05-29-003 always interpolates target to bomber position; edge-clamp only prevents going OFF-screen, not centring. The fix is small math change to the camera-follow target computation. Marked `should` because the current camera works (no functional bug) but feels off on fits-in-view arenas — direct UX improvement on existing system.
acceptanceHints: TARGET FILE: `examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/camera-follow-system.ts` (from S163).
ALGORITHM CHANGE (per X and Z axes independently):
view_size_tiles = current orthographic view size OR computed perspective frustum at floor (already known from camera setup).
arena_size_x = arena width (gridWidth × cellSize)
arena_size_z = arena depth (gridDepth × cellSize)
PER AXIS:
follow_factor_x = clamp((arena_size_x - view_size_tiles) / arena_size_x, 0, 1)
follow_factor_z = clamp((arena_size_z - view_size_tiles) / arena_size_z, 0, 1)
follow_factor_x = max(follow_factor_x, MIN_PARALLAX)  // never fully static
follow_factor_z = max(follow_factor_z, MIN_PARALLAX)
target_camera_x = arena_center_x × (1 - follow_factor_x) + bomber_x × follow_factor_x
target_camera_z = arena_center_z × (1 - follow_factor_z) + bomber_z × follow_factor_z
target_camera_y = bomber_y + cameraOffset.y (unchanged from S163).
EXISTING DAMPING: lerp from current to target with the existing S163 damping (~0.12 × dt × 60 — feels stable).
EXISTING EDGE-CLAMP: still applies as a final pass, but rarely needed since adaptive follow keeps view within arena bounds naturally.
CONSTANTS:
MIN_PARALLAX = 0.05 (5% of bomber-offset stays in target even on fully-fits arenas — preserves 'tiny breathing motion' per user feedback)
view_size_tiles = 11 by default (matches S163 default).
BEHAVIOUR EXAMPLES at view=11 tiles:
Pit 11×11 → X: follow_factor = max(0, 0.05) = 0.05 (5% follow); Z: 0.05. Result: camera nearly centred, tiny parallax with bomber motion.
Plaza 13×11 → X: (13-11)/13 = 0.154; Z: max(0, 0.05) = 0.05. Result: small X drift toward bomber, Z mostly centred.
Default 15×11 → X: (15-11)/15 = 0.267; Z: 0.05. Result: moderate X follow, near-centred Z.
Wide 17×13 → X: (17-11)/17 = 0.353; Z: (13-11)/13 = 0.154. Result: balanced moderate follow on both axes.
Corridor 21×7 → X: (21-11)/21 = 0.476; Z: max(0, 0.05) = 0.05. Result: strong X follow (corridor needs it), Z mostly centred (it's shorter than view).
Cross 17×17 → X: 0.353; Z: 0.353. Symmetric moderate follow on both.
Hypothetical 30×30 arena → X+Z both: 0.633. Heavy follow.
VIEW-SIZE OVERRIDE INTERACTION:
S163 supported `?viewSize=N` to change view tile count. Adaptive follow respects this: if viewSize is changed, follow_factor recomputes per the new view_size.
Setting viewSize=4 (very zoomed in) on a 15×11 arena → high follow on both axes (camera fully tracks bomber).
Setting viewSize=20 (very zoomed out) on a 15×11 arena → arena fits → near-centred + MIN_PARALLAX.
URL CONFIG:
`?minParallax=N` overrides MIN_PARALLAX (default 0.05). Set to 0 for fully static camera on fits-in-view arenas; set to 1 for full follow regardless (current behaviour).
`?adaptiveCamera=off` disables the adaptive factor entirely — reverts to S163 full-follow + edge-clamp behaviour. Useful for screenshot tests OR for users who prefer aggressive follow.
INTERACTION WITH OTHER CAMERA SYSTEMS:
Round-resolve zoom-in (GDP-2026-05-29-003): the zoom-in moment still WINS — adaptive follow paused during the 1.0s zoom + 3.0s banner + 0.4s reset. After auto-restart, adaptive follow resumes.
Spawn flicker-in (GDP-2026-05-29-003): flicker-in also wins for its 0.3s duration; adaptive follow resumes after.
Variable height (GDP-2026-05-28-010): Y-axis camera follow is unaffected — Y tracks bomber height with the same S163 lerp, no adaptive factor (heights are universal across arena sizes).

Dead bomber (S163 hold behaviour): when local bomber alive=false, camera holds at last-living-position for 0.6s. Adaptive follow respects this — uses last-living-position as the bomber_x/z input during the hold.
VISIBILITY OF FOLLOW MOTION:

At MIN_PARALLAX=0.05, a bomber walking from arena edge to centre causes ~5% of (edge-to-centre) camera shift = ~0.25 cells max on a 15×11 arena. Subtle but visible — provides the 'screen feels alive' parallax user requested.
DETERMINISM: pure presentation. Bot-vs-bot regression unaffected.
TESTS:
Pit 11×11 arena, bomber at (10, 10), view=11: target_camera_xz ≈ arena_center + MIN_PARALLAX × (bomber - arena_center).
Corridor 21×7 arena, bomber at (20, 3), view=11: target_camera_x heavily follows bomber, target_camera_z near arena_center_z.
view_size override: ?viewSize=4 → follow_factor → max value on small arena.
?minParallax=0 → fully centred on fits-in-view arena.
?adaptiveCamera=off → reverts to S163 follow logic.
Bomber walks E→W on default 15×11 arena, view=11: camera moves ~27% of bomber-X-delta, NOT full bomber-delta.
VISUAL QA:
Load pit arena → bomber moves around, camera barely moves (subtle parallax).
Load corridor → bomber moves along long axis, camera follows in X direction; bomber moves cross-corridor, camera doesn't move (Z fits).
Load cross arena → camera follows in both axes moderately.
Load default arena → camera mostly stays near centre, small follow as bomber moves toward corners.
No 'camera randomly drifting' feel — every camera move is justified by bomber position toward the arena edge.
DOCS UPDATES (in this PR):
visual-style.md §7.2 — note the adaptive follow factor as the current shipped behaviour. Document the MIN_PARALLAX constant.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Per-arena follow factor overrides (each arena uses the algorithmic computation).
Look-ahead direction bias scaling (S163 look-ahead 0.5 cells stays unchanged — independent of follow factor).
Camera shake / zoom-in tied to gameplay events (separate from S163 / GDP-029-003).
Player-controllable camera mode (free / orbit / centre). Adaptive follow + URL flag are the only modes.
